headline: On November 9, 2023: NYU Langone Health performs first whole eye transplant
captionCards: Paves the way for future organ regeneration techniques
instagramCaption:
NYU Langone Health makes history.

Surgeons at NYU Langone Health in New York performed the world’s first successful whole eye transplant on November 9, 2023. The procedure took place at one of the health system’s seven inpatient facilities. The team included specialists from NYU Grossman School of Medicine. This milestone occurred within a healthcare system with over 55,000 employees and more than 400 locations.

It marks a major advancement in regenerative medicine and transplant surgery.
